title: docs(guide): slotted-pages' "customize only the header" example writes `eyebrow` and `icon` on a `page:header`, which the contract refuses
body:
Filing-gate category: ③ a docs example that teaches a node the contract refuses, class (c). `reach:` a named producer, the docs example itself: `content/docs/guide/slotted-pages.md`, "Example: customize only the header". AI authors transcribe docs examples.
- **Measured.** The objectui#3906 dev ran objectui's `safeValidateSchema` on the example's exact node at PR objectui#11162's head `c79ae7497`. It is refused with `properties.icon: invalid_type` and `properties: unrecognized_keys [eyebrow]`. In the control, the same node without `eyebrow` and `icon` validates OK.
- **Confirmed at source.** PR objectui#11162's contract review (`5902367106`, ③ out-of-scope (c)) confirmed it real at the head and pre-existing. The spec row `ComponentPropsMap['page:header']` (`PageHeaderProps`, a `strictObject`) declares no `eyebrow` and tombstones `icon` (ADR-0087 D2: removed in `@objectstack/spec` 17.0.0, no renderer ever read it). The fence types `properties` as an open record, so no snippet gate catches it.

Reader: triage first (grade and route), then the seat that dispatches it. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`) at the ACCEPT of PR objectui#11162 (objectui#3906, Phase 2, which taught the canonical `page:header` node on its own reference page), from the dev report's `out_of_scope_findings[0]` (`5902224540`). ⛔ Not graded here.

## The site (read at objectui `origin/main` `a8c550938`)

`content/docs/guide/slotted-pages.md`, the `AccountDetailPage` example, `slots.header`:

```ts
header: {
  type: 'page:header',
  id: 'account_header_slotted',
  properties: {
    title: '{name}',
    subtitle: '{industry} · {type}',
    eyebrow: 'ACCOUNT',       // not a PageHeaderProps key
    icon: 'building-2',       // tombstoned (ADR-0087 D2)
    breadcrumb: true,
  },
},
```

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

- The example keeps only keys `PageHeaderProps` accepts. Drop `eyebrow` and `icon`. `content/docs/layout/page-header.mdx` (rewritten by PR objectui#11162) is the prop reference to point at.
- `breadcrumb: true` is accepted, but today it draws only an empty slot; that is the separate seam card filed with this one. Whether the example keeps it follows that card.
- Pin: the example's header node passes `safeValidateSchema` and the spec row's full parse. The control is the old node, refused on `eyebrow` and `icon`. The existing docs-snippet tests are the natural home, if one reads this page.

## Dedupe

The 1000 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs (down to #10338) were grepped:
- `eyebrow`, `account_header_slotted` and `customize only the header`: only PR objectui#11162 (the source).
- `slotted-pages`: three closed PRs that cite the page for other claims (objectui#10470 action placement, objectui#10649 refresh, objectui#10870 page kinds).

No card covers this.
